title: Equivalence testing and run-count design for stochastic machine-learning experiments
abstract: arXiv:2610.23700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Claims that two training methods perform equally well often rest on a non-significant difference between two or three runs per method. We develop a protocol, with its power theory, for certifying practical equivalence in per-run metrics such as the AUROC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve). It rests on a two-level (seed x item) variance model separating between-run dispersion from item-level noise. Equivalence within a pre-specified margin is tested by two one-sided tests (TOST), equivalently by a confidence interval inside the margin; a two-level bootstrap covers composite statistics. A closed-form formula converts a margin and a target power into runs per method; its shifted-t refinement is calibrated against the realised two-level process. translated_title: 随机机器学习实验的等效性检验与运行次数设计
translated_abstract: 关于两种训练方法表现相当的论断，往往仅建立在每种方法两到三次运行之间无显著差异的基础上。我们开发了一套用于认证单次运行指标（如AUROC，受试者工作特征曲线下面积）实际等效性的方案及其功效理论。该方案建立在一个两级（种子×样本）方差模型之上，将运行间离散度与样本级噪声分离开来。预设容差范围内的等效性通过两次单侧检验（TOST）进行验证，等价地也可以通过位于容差范围内的置信区间来验证；两级自助法（bootstrap）可覆盖复合统计量。一个闭式公式可将容差和目标功效转换为每种方法所需的运行次数；其移位t分布的改进版本则根据实际的两级过程进行校准。在270个单元网格上以及非高斯种子分布规律下的仿真实验证实，该公式在其设计相关范围内（从每种方法五次运行开始）是有效的。对于四次已发表的联合……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一套基于两级（种子×样本）方差模型和TOST等效性检验的严格认证方案，并给出将预设容差与目标功效换算为所需运行次数的闭式公式，从而取代以往仅凭两三次运行无显著差异就宣称方法等效的不可靠做法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rigorous equivalence certification protocol based on a two-level (seed × item) variance model and TOST testing, along with a closed-form formula that converts a pre-specified margin and target power into the required number of runs per method, replacing unreliable claims of method equivalence based on merely two or three runs.
